scripts.dev: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build -w @hesta-codex/shared && concurrently -k -n web,api "npm run dev -w @hesta-codex/web" "npm run dev -w @hesta-codex/api"
scripts.typecheck: npm run prisma:generate && npm run typecheck:prisma && npm run build -w @hesta-codex/shared && npm run typecheck -w @hesta-codex/shared && npm run typecheck -w @hesta-codex/api && npm run typecheck -w @hesta-codex/web
scripts.test: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build -w @hesta-codex/shared && npm run test -w @hesta-codex/api && npm run test -w @hesta-codex/web
scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build -w @hesta-codex/shared && npm run build -w @hesta-codex/api && npm run build -w @hesta-codex/web
scripts.prisma:seed: npm run prisma:generate && prisma db seed
